protocols.evidenceNotes: Secondary commercial source; these are the page's statements, not independently verified clinical guidance. Fixed blend: 6 mg AOD-9604 + 3 mg CJC-1295 + 3 mg ipamorelin; all withdrawals retain ratio, so components cannot be dosed separately. Source reference: 12 mg total + 3 mL bacteriostatic water and about 400 mcg total blend per dose. Research-use-only; blend not clinically validated.

schedule.description: Total blend dose only; fixed 6:3:3 mg component ratio cannot be dosed separately.

regimen.notes: Source says the 12 mg blend is reconstituted with 3 mL and describes about 400 mcg total blend per dose. Combination is not clinically validated.
